The hand-off promise

When I leave, nothing leaves with me.

I've been the owner stuck waiting on a developer to change a headline. So every Prancer site is a custom theme you can edit yourself, and I teach you how before I go.

100% editable

Every section, word and image lives in the Shopify editor. No code to touch, ever.

Hand-off training

A boutique walkthrough of your own site, recorded so you can rewatch it.

60 days of support

Questions after launch are part of the project, not a new invoice.

Unlimited revisions

We iterate on the design until it's right. Your feedback speed sets the pace.

How it works

Two to three weeks, start to launch.

Payment is split in two: half to begin, half at launch. Timelines move at the speed of your feedback.

About

Named after a dog. Run by an operator.

Prancer is my Bernese Mountain Dog (Bentley is his dad). Before I built websites for other people I built and ran the businesses behind them: a women's health brand from zero to a $2.5M valuation in nine months, a farm's subscription club from 200 to 1,000 members, and restaurants, a winery and a brewery along the way.

The eldest of six, I like people, hosting dinner parties, pottery from places I've traveled, and a phone call over a text, any day. That's how I run projects too.

People

Real relationships with clients and their customers. Subscriptions grow on trust.

Presenting

I've taught Shopify workshops and pitched brands. Your site should present you that well.

Problem solving

Competitive, on-the-fly, and happy to design a system in days when days are what you have.
